verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The added self-tests are diff-scoped, non-vacuous mutation guards for the existing enabled-fleet filter in the provider-capped scan. They independently assert firing state, exact enabled-account reset selection, absence of the rotated-out reset from the action, enabled-only churn count, and the non-firing path. The expected values are literal and distinct from the filtered fixture value, so removing or conditionally bypassing the filter for limit records makes the checks fail. The success-row portion does not create a separate observable effect because popping a never-inserted non-enabled account is a no-op, but the later non-enabled limit record still exercises and detects weakening of the shared filter. No trust check is weakened, no production behavior changes, and no injection-like instruction appears in the diff.
